main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads grids from standard input and, for each test case, prints the size of the largest connected subset of cells for which there exists a pivot cell such that each quadrant around the pivot contains at most one distinct character." main]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> args </REF>: String[] "Command-line arguments, not used by this method."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize br as a BufferedReader wrapping InputStreamReader(System.in), initialize pw as a PrintWriter wrapping BufferedWriter wrapping OutputStreamWriter(System.out), and read integer qq by calling readInt(). RESULT io_and_qq]
            [COMMAND For each casenum from 1 to qq inclusive, process one test case, printing prefix 'Case #' concatenated with casenum and ': ' first. RESULT case_iteration]
            [COMMAND Within the outer test-case loop, read grid dimensions r and c with readInt(), set ret to 1, and allocate char[][] g of size r by c. RESULT r_c_g_ret]
            [COMMAND Within the outer test-case loop, for each row i from 0 to r-1, read token s with nextToken() and copy s.charAt(j) into g[i][j] for each column j from 0 to c-1. RESULT grid_filled]
            [COMMAND Within the outer test-case loop, for each mask from 1 to (1<<(r*c))-1 inclusive, skip the mask when Integer.bitCount(mask) is not greater than ret. RESULT mask_pruned]
            [COMMAND For the current mask, copy mask into t, allocate par as a new int array of length r*c, and initialize par[i] to i for i from 0 to r*c-1. RESULT par_initialized]
            [COMMAND Allocate boolean[][] use of size r by c; for each row i from 0 to r-1 and each column j from 0 to c-1, set use[i][j] to true when the least significant bit of t is 1, then shift t right by one. RESULT use_built]
            [COMMAND Set numNeed to Integer.bitCount(mask) minus 1. RESULT numNeed_initialized]
            [COMMAND For each selected cell use[i][j], if the down neighbor is selected and merge(i*c+j, (i+1)*c+j) succeeds, decrement numNeed; if the right neighbor is selected and merge(i*c+j, i*c+j+1) succeeds, decrement numNeed. RESULT dsu_merged]
            [COMMAND If numNeed is not zero, skip this mask because the selected cells are disconnected. RESULT connected_check]
            [COMMAND For the current connected mask, set valid to false, then search for a pivot (i,j) with i from 0 to r-1 and j from 0 to c-1, stopping early once valid becomes true. RESULT validity_search_started]
            [COMMAND For each pivot candidate, allocate Set<Character>[] all with four HashSet instances and set good to true. RESULT all_sets_initialized]
            [COMMAND For each selected cell (x,y), while good remains true, compute quadrant idx as 0 plus 2 if x>i plus 1 if y<j, add g[x][y] to all[idx], and set good to true if all[idx].size() is less than 2, else set good to false. RESULT quadrant_check]
            [COMMAND After the x,y scan for the current pivot, assign valid = good; if valid becomes true, stop the pivot search. RESULT validity_assigned]
            [COMMAND If the current mask is not valid, skip it. RESULT validity_pruned]
            [COMMAND If the current mask is connected and valid, update ret to Integer.bitCount(mask). RESULT ret_updated]
            [COMMAND After all masks have been processed for the current test case, print ret with pw.println(ret). RESULT answer_printed]
            [COMMAND After all test cases have been processed, close pw with pw.close(). RESULT output_closed]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]
